workbenches.name: Geometry Formula Workbench
workbenches.description: Explore plane and solid geometry formulas with explicit dimensions, units, assumptions, and multiple derived results.

formulas.name: Regular Polygon Properties
formulas.description: Area, perimeter, and apothem of a regular polygon from its side count and side length.
formulas.note: A = n·s² / (4·tan(π/n)).

formulas.name: Triangle Area (Heron)
formulas.description: Triangle area from three side lengths using Heron's formula, plus the perimeter.
formulas.note: Heron's formula: A = √(s(s-a)(s-b)(s-c)), s = (a+b+c)/2.

guards.message: The three sides must satisfy the triangle inequality.

formulas.name: Trapezoid Area
formulas.description: Area of a trapezoid from the two parallel sides and the height between them.

formulas.name: Ellipse Area
formulas.description: Area of an ellipse from its semi-major and semi-minor axes.
formulas.note: A = π·a·b.

formulas.name: Ellipse Perimeter (Ramanujan)
formulas.description: Approximate circumference of an ellipse using Ramanujan's first approximation.

formulas.name: Annulus Area
formulas.description: Area of the ring between two concentric circles given outer and inner radii.
formulas.note: A = π(R² − r²).

guards.message: Outer radius R must be greater than or equal to inner radius r.

formulas.name: Circle Sector Properties
formulas.description: Area and arc length of a circular sector from radius and central angle in degrees.
formulas.note: A = θ/360 · πr²; arc = r·θ (θ in rad).

formulas.name: Circular Segment Properties
formulas.description: Area and chord length of a circular segment from radius and central angle in degrees.
formulas.note: Central angle θ selects the minor segment for 0<θ≤180° and the major segment for 180°<θ≤360°; chord length is the shared boundary chord.

formulas.name: Circular Ring Sector Area
formulas.description: Area of a ring sector (annular sector) from outer and inner radii and the angle in degrees.
formulas.note: A = θ/360 · π(R² − r²).

guards.message: Outer radius R must be greater than or equal to inner radius r.

formulas.name: Rhombus Properties
formulas.description: Area, side length, and perimeter of a rhombus from its two diagonals.

formulas.name: Parallelogram Area
formulas.description: Area of a parallelogram from its base and the perpendicular height.
formulas.note: A = base · height.

formulas.name: Kite Area
formulas.description: Area of a kite from the lengths of its two diagonals.

formulas.name: Conical Surface Area
formulas.description: Lateral surface area of a right cone from its base radius and slant height.
formulas.note: Lateral area πrl for a nondegenerate right circular cone; slant height must exceed radius.

guards.message: A nondegenerate right cone requires slant height l greater than radius r.

formulas.name: Cone Frustum Volume
formulas.description: Volume and lateral area of a conical frustum from the two radii and height.
formulas.note: R and r are the radii of either circular end; either may be larger. Height is perpendicular between the end planes.

formulas.name: Torus Properties
formulas.description: Volume and surface area of a torus from its major and minor radii.
formulas.note: Ring-torus model: R is measured from the torus center to the tube centerline, and r is the tube radius; R must exceed r.

guards.message: A ring torus requires major radius R greater than minor radius r.

formulas.name: Ellipsoid Volume
formulas.description: Volume of an ellipsoid from its three semi-axes.

formulas.name: Hemisphere Properties
formulas.description: Curved surface area and volume of a hemisphere from its radius.
formulas.note: Curved surface area = 2πr² and volume = 2/3 πr³. The circular base is excluded; including it gives total area 3πr².

formulas.name: Spherical Cap Properties
formulas.description: Volume and cap surface area of a spherical cap from sphere radius and cap height.
formulas.note: Cap volume = πh²(3R−h)/3. Curved cap area = 2πRh and excludes the circular base.

guards.message: Cap height h must not exceed the sphere diameter 2R.

formulas.name: Cube Space Diagonal
formulas.description: Space diagonal and face diagonal of a cube from its edge length.

formulas.name: Rectangular Prism Diagonal
formulas.description: Space diagonal and volume of a rectangular prism from length, width, and height.
formulas.note: d = √(l²+w²+h²).

formulas.name: Tetrahedron Properties
formulas.description: Volume and total surface area of a regular tetrahedron from its edge length.

formulas.name: Octahedron Properties
formulas.description: Volume and surface area of a regular octahedron from its edge length.

formulas.name: Icosahedron Properties
formulas.description: Volume and surface area of a regular icosahedron from its edge length.

formulas.name: Dodecahedron Properties
formulas.description: Volume and surface area of a regular dodecahedron from its edge length.

formulas.name: Pentagonal Prism Volume
formulas.description: Volume of a regular pentagonal prism from its base edge and height.

formulas.name: Hexagonal Prism Volume
formulas.description: Volume of a regular hexagonal prism from its base edge and height.

formulas.name: Reuleaux Triangle Properties
formulas.description: Area and perimeter of a Reuleaux triangle from its width (side of generating triangle).
formulas.note: A = (π−√3)/2 · s²; perimeter = πs.

formulas.name: Triangle Area (Base & Height)
formulas.description: Area of a triangle from its base and perpendicular height.
formulas.note: A = ½ · b · h.

formulas.name: Prism Volume
formulas.description: Volume of a general prism from its base area and height.
formulas.note: V = base area · height.

workbenches.name: Physics & Astronomy Formula Workbench
workbenches.description: Calculate educational mechanics, fluids, heat, optics, gravity, and astronomy formulas from one maintained interface.

formulas.name: Pendulum Period
formulas.description: Period of a simple pendulum from its length and local gravity.
formulas.note: Small-angle simple-pendulum approximation with a point mass, massless inextensible string, constant g, and no damping.

formulas.name: Pendulum Length from Period
formulas.description: Pendulum length required for a target period at a given gravity.
formulas.note: Inverts the small-angle simple-pendulum period for a point mass, massless inextensible string, constant g, and no damping.

formulas.name: Spring Potential Energy
formulas.description: Elastic potential energy stored in a spring from its stiffness and displacement.
formulas.note: Ideal linear spring: energy=½kx² and force magnitude=kx for nonnegative displacement magnitude x.

formulas.name: Kinetic Energy & Momentum
formulas.description: Kinetic energy and momentum of a moving mass from its mass and velocity.
formulas.note: Classical one-dimensional formulas; velocity is signed and restricted to |v|≤0.1c, while kinetic energy is nonnegative.

formulas.name: Gravitational Potential Energy
formulas.description: Gravitational potential energy from mass, height, and gravity.
formulas.note: Near-surface uniform-field change ΔU=mgΔh relative to a chosen height datum; this is not the general inverse-square potential.

formulas.name: Impulse Calculator
formulas.description: Impulse delivered by a constant force over a time interval.
formulas.note: J = F·t.

formulas.name: Centripetal Acceleration & Force
formulas.description: Centripetal acceleration and the force required to keep a mass on a circular path.
formulas.note: Uniform circular motion using speed and radius; outputs are inward acceleration and force magnitudes.

formulas.name: Projectile Motion Properties
formulas.description: Range, maximum height, and time of flight of a projectile from speed and launch angle.
formulas.note: Ideal point-particle projectile launched and landing at the same elevation, with constant g=9.81 m/s² and no air resistance.

formulas.name: Free Fall Properties
formulas.description: Distance fallen and final velocity for an object in free fall over a time.
formulas.note: Object dropped from rest under constant g with no drag; distance and speed are downward magnitudes.

formulas.name: Angular Velocity
formulas.description: Angular velocity in rad/s from an angular displacement (degrees) and time.
formulas.note: Average angular velocity over the stated time interval, not instantaneous angular velocity.

formulas.name: Rotational Kinetic Energy
formulas.description: Rotational kinetic energy from moment of inertia and angular velocity.
formulas.note: Fixed-axis rigid-body rotational energy, using moment of inertia about that axis.

formulas.name: Specific Heat Energy
formulas.description: Heat required to raise a mass by a temperature difference using specific heat capacity.
formulas.note: Q=mcΔT with constant specific heat and no phase change; positive Q is absorbed and negative Q is released.

formulas.name: Latent Heat Energy
formulas.description: Energy absorbed or released during a phase change from mass and latent heat.
formulas.note: Phase-change energy magnitude mL at constant transition conditions; direction and sign are not represented.

formulas.name: Young's Modulus
formulas.description: Young's modulus, stress, and strain from force, area, original length, and extension.
formulas.note: Engineering stress and strain for uniform uniaxial, linear-elastic, small-strain loading; area is original cross-section and L original length.

formulas.name: Snell Refractive Index
formulas.description: Relative refractive index from incident and refracted angles (degrees).
formulas.note: Snell's law gives n₂/n₁=sin(incident)/sin(refracted); both angles are measured from the surface normal and kept below 90°.

formulas.name: Buoyant Force
formulas.description: Buoyant force on a submerged volume from fluid density and gravity.
formulas.note: Archimedean buoyant-force magnitude for displaced volume in a fluid of uniform density and constant g.

formulas.name: Escape Velocity
formulas.description: Escape velocity from a body of given mass and radius.
formulas.note: Newtonian escape speed from the surface radius of a spherical body; ignores atmosphere and rotation and rejects compact-body results at or above c.

guards.message: This Newtonian formula is not valid when the computed escape speed reaches the speed of light.

formulas.name: Orbital Period
formulas.description: Orbital period of a small body around a central mass at a given orbital radius.
formulas.note: Keplerian period for semi-major axis a around a point/spherical central mass; orbiting mass is negligible. A circular orbit has a equal to orbital radius.

formulas.name: Gravitational Force
formulas.description: Newtonian gravitational attraction between two masses separated by a distance.
formulas.note: Newtonian force magnitude for point or spherically symmetric masses at center-to-center separation r.

formulas.name: Schwarzschild Radius
formulas.description: Schwarzschild radius (event horizon) of a non-rotating mass.
formulas.note: Schwarzschild radius for an isolated, nonrotating, uncharged mass.

formulas.name: Star Luminosity (Stefan-Boltzmann)
formulas.description: Total luminosity of a blackbody sphere from its radius and surface temperature.
formulas.note: Ideal blackbody luminosity 4πR²σT⁴ using the 2022 CODATA Stefan–Boltzmann constant.

formulas.name: Angular Size
formulas.description: Apparent angular size in arcseconds from an object's size and its distance.
formulas.note: Exact angular diameter for transverse size centered perpendicular to the line of sight: 2·atan(size/(2·distance)), converted to arcseconds.

formulas.name: Light Travel Time
formulas.description: Time for light to cross a distance, in seconds and in years.
formulas.note: Vacuum light-travel time using exact c=299,792,458 m/s; years use 31,557,600 seconds.

formulas.name: Weight on a Body
formulas.description: Weight (force) of a mass in a gravitational field of given strength.
formulas.note: W = mg.

formulas.name: de Broglie Wavelength
formulas.description: Non-relativistic de Broglie wavelength of a particle from its mass and speed.
formulas.note: Uses λ=h/(mv) with non-relativistic momentum; speed is restricted to 0.1c or less. Use relativistic momentum outside this range.

formulas.name: Terminal Velocity
formulas.description: Terminal velocity of a falling object from mass, drag coefficient, area, and fluid density.
formulas.note: Quadratic-drag steady-state speed with constant Cd, fluid density, and projected area; buoyancy is omitted and may matter in liquids.

formulas.name: Hydrostatic Pressure
formulas.description: Calculate gauge pressure increase at depth in a constant-density fluid.
formulas.note: Gauge pressure increase ρgh relative to the free surface; add surface pressure for absolute pressure.

formulas.name: Capillary Rise
formulas.description: Estimate signed capillary rise or depression in a narrow tube.
formulas.note: Signed capillary height 2γcos(θ)/(ρgr); contact angles above 90° produce a negative depression.

formulas.name: Reynolds Number
formulas.description: Reynolds number for flow from density, velocity, length, and dynamic viscosity.
formulas.note: Re=ρvL/μ using speed and a chosen characteristic length; interpretation depends on the flow geometry.

formulas.name: Bernoulli Pressure
formulas.description: Downstream pressure from Bernoulli's principle given upstream pressure and two velocities.
formulas.note: Same-elevation Bernoulli relation along a streamline for steady incompressible inviscid flow, with no pumps or losses. P1 and P2 share the same gauge or absolute basis.

formulas.name: Star Distance (Distance Modulus)
formulas.description: Distance in parsecs from apparent and absolute magnitude.
formulas.note: Apparent and absolute magnitudes must use the same band; extinction and K-correction are omitted.

formulas.name: Hohmann Transfer Period
formulas.description: Half-period of a Hohmann transfer around the Sun between two orbital radii.
formulas.note: Half-transfer time = 0.5·√a³ years for ideal coplanar circular heliocentric orbits, impulsive burns, radii in AU, and one solar-mass central body; direction is symmetric.

formulas.name: Planet Orbital Period (Kepler)
formulas.description: Orbital period in years from semi-major axis in AU around a Sun-mass star.
formulas.note: Kepler period in years for AU semi-major axis around one solar mass, assuming negligible planet mass.

formulas.name: Redshift Velocity (Relativistic)
formulas.description: Convert redshift to its special-relativistic Doppler-equivalent radial velocity.
formulas.note: Special-relativistic Doppler equivalent radial velocity from z; this is not a general cosmological recession-distance interpretation.

formulas.name: Telescope Magnification
formulas.description: Magnification of a telescope from its focal length and the eyepiece focal length.
formulas.note: Ideal angular magnification magnitude ft/fe; actual useful magnification is limited by optics, aperture, and seeing.

formulas.name: Telescope Light Gathering
formulas.description: Light-gathering power relative to a 7 mm dark-adapted eye pupil.
formulas.note: Ideal clear-aperture area ratio relative to a 7 mm eye pupil; obstruction, transmission losses, and the observer's actual pupil are omitted.

workbenches.name: Finance Formula Workbench
workbenches.description: Compare time-value, return, pricing, depreciation, and affordability formulas without treating estimates as financial advice.

formulas.name: Present Value (Lump Sum)
formulas.description: Present value of a future lump sum discounted at a periodic rate over n periods.
formulas.note: Discounts one future amount using an effective periodic decimal rate for n matching periods.

formulas.name: Future Value (Lump Sum)
formulas.description: Future value of a present amount compounded at a periodic rate over n periods.
formulas.note: Compounds one present amount using an effective periodic decimal rate for n matching periods.

formulas.name: Future Value of an Annuity
formulas.description: Future value of a series of equal periodic payments at a periodic rate.
formulas.note: Ordinary-annuity FV; payments occur at period ends. At a zero periodic rate, FV = PMT·n.

formulas.name: Present Value of an Annuity
formulas.description: Present value of a series of equal periodic payments at a periodic rate.
formulas.note: Ordinary-annuity PV; payments occur at period ends. At a zero periodic rate, PV = PMT·n.

formulas.name: Straight-Line Depreciation
formulas.description: Annual depreciation and total depreciable amount from cost, salvage value, and useful life.
formulas.note: Generic accounting arithmetic allocating cost less salvage evenly over whole years; not a tax-depreciation method or eligibility determination.

guards.message: Salvage value must not exceed original cost.

formulas.name: Declining Balance Depreciation
formulas.description: First-year depreciation under the declining-balance method from book value and rate.
formulas.note: Applies one decimal-period declining rate to opening book value; generic accounting arithmetic, not tax-depreciation guidance.

formulas.name: Cap Rate
formulas.description: Capitalization rate from net operating income and property value.
formulas.note: Unlevered annual NOI divided by property price, shown as a percentage; NOI definitions and transaction costs vary.

formulas.name: Dividend Yield
formulas.description: Dividend yield from annual dividends per share and price per share.
formulas.note: Annual dividend per share divided by current price; does not represent total return or guarantee future dividends.

formulas.name: Gross Margin & Markup
formulas.description: Gross margin and markup percentage from selling price and unit cost.
formulas.note: Per-unit gross margin and markup from price and cost; included costs must use a consistent accounting definition.

formulas.name: Markup Price
formulas.description: Selling price from unit cost and a markup percentage.
formulas.note: Adds a percentage markup on cost; markup percent is not the same as gross-margin percent.

formulas.name: Break-Even Units
formulas.description: Number of units to sell to break even from fixed costs, price, and variable cost per unit.
formulas.note: Exact quantity = fixed cost/(price−variable cost); minimum whole units uses an ULP-aware ceiling.

guards.message: Price must be greater than variable cost.

formulas.name: Rule of 72
formulas.description: Years to double an investment using the rule of 72 and the exact logarithmic value.
formulas.note: Rule-of-72 approximation and exact annual compounding time using a positive annual percentage rate.

formulas.name: Inflation Future Cost
formulas.description: Future cost of an item after years of inflation at a constant annual rate.
formulas.note: Compounds a constant annual inflation percentage for whole years; actual inflation varies over time and by item.

formulas.name: Price Elasticity of Demand
formulas.description: Price elasticity of demand from percentage change in quantity and price.
formulas.note: Simple signed percentage-change ratio %ΔQ/%ΔP; not arc elasticity, and the selected baseline affects percentage changes.

guards.message: Price change must not be zero.

formulas.name: Cash-on-Cash Return
formulas.description: Cash-on-cash return from annual cash flow and cash invested.
formulas.note: Annual pre-tax cash flow divided by invested cash; financing, reserve, and cash-flow definitions must be consistent.

formulas.name: Compound Annual Growth Rate
formulas.description: CAGR from beginning value, ending value, and number of periods.
formulas.note: Smoothed annual growth rate between positive beginning and ending values over whole years; path volatility is omitted.

formulas.name: Discount Factor
formulas.description: Present-value discount factor for a rate and number of periods.
formulas.note: Discount factor for an effective periodic decimal rate over n matching periods.

formulas.name: Perpetuity Present Value
formulas.description: Present value of a perpetuity from the periodic payment and discount rate.
formulas.note: Level perpetuity with the first payment one period from now and a positive effective periodic decimal discount rate.

formulas.name: Debt-to-Income Ratio
formulas.description: Debt-to-income ratio from monthly debt payments and gross monthly income.
formulas.note: Debt payment divided by income as a percentage; lender definitions (gross/net income and included debts) vary.

formulas.name: Loan-to-Value Ratio
formulas.description: Loan-to-value ratio from loan amount and appraised property value.
formulas.note: Loan balance divided by property value; valuation basis and treatment of multiple liens vary.

workbenches.name: Construction & Materials Workbench
workbenches.description: Estimate common material quantities and dimensions for early planning, with formulas and unit assumptions shown.

formulas.name: Concrete Column Volume
formulas.description: Volume of a cylindrical concrete column from its diameter and height.
formulas.note: V = πr²h.

formulas.name: Excavation Volume
formulas.description: Volume of material to excavate from length, width, and depth.
formulas.note: Rectangular in-place (bank) volume only; side slopes, overdig, swell, shrinkage, and haul quantities are omitted.

formulas.name: Slope Percentage
formulas.description: Slope percentage and the 1-in-n ratio from vertical rise and horizontal run.
formulas.note: Slope% = rise/run · 100.

formulas.name: Staircase Riser Count
formulas.description: Estimate riser count, actual riser height, tread count, and straight-flight run from geometric inputs.
formulas.note: Geometry only: risers=ceil(height/maximum riser), actual riser=height/count, treads=count−1, and straight-flight run=treads·tread depth. Verify local stair codes and landings.

formulas.name: Drywall Sheet Count
formulas.description: Number of 4×8 ft drywall sheets needed for a wall area with a waste factor.
formulas.note: 1 sheet = 32 ft² (4×8).

formulas.name: Tile Quantity
formulas.description: Number of tiles needed for an area given tile size and a waste percentage.
formulas.note: Tiles = area / (tw·th) · (1 + waste%).

formulas.name: Roofing Bundle Count
formulas.description: Estimate roofing bundles using the selected product's bundles-per-100-ft² coverage.
formulas.note: Enter the manufacturer's bundles required per 100 ft² for the exact product; package coverage varies substantially. Waste is then added before an ULP-aware ceiling.

formulas.name: Insulation Total R-Value
formulas.description: Add nominal US R-values for ideal one-dimensional layers in series.
formulas.note: US customary R-values only (h·ft²·°F/Btu), added for ideal 1-D series layers. This is not whole-assembly R-value; bridges, gaps, compression, and air films are omitted.

formulas.name: Gravel Tonnage
formulas.description: Tonnage of gravel from volume and bulk density.
formulas.note: Mass = volume · density.

formulas.name: Rebar Mass
formulas.description: Estimate reinforcing-bar mass from nominal diameter and length.
formulas.note: Approximate metric rebar mass d²/162·L; verify the applicable bar standard and actual unit mass.

formulas.name: Wallpaper Roll Count
formulas.description: Estimate rolls from usable roll coverage and a generic area allowance.
formulas.note: Allowance is a generic percentage added to area, not a pattern-repeat length. For patterned wallpaper, calculate usable drop-based roll coverage separately and enter that coverage.

formulas.name: Brick Quantity
formulas.description: Estimate brick count from installed module dimensions, including mortar joints.
formulas.note: Width and height are installed module dimensions (brick plus mortar joint), not bare brick dimensions. The count uses an ULP-aware ceiling after the waste allowance.

formulas.name: Roof Slope Multiplier
formulas.description: Roof area multiplier from rise and run to convert plan area to sloped area.
formulas.note: Rise and run describe the same ridge-to-eave roof section; run is not the full building span. Multiplier is slope length divided by horizontal run.

formulas.name: Concrete Bag Count
formulas.description: Number of premixed concrete bags from required volume and bag yield.
formulas.note: Bags = volume / yield per bag.

workbenches.name: Workshop & Crafts Formula Workbench
workbenches.description: Use machining, welding, sewing, knitting, crochet, and fabric planning formulas in one practical workspace.

formulas.name: Bolt Circle Spacing
formulas.description: Arc spacing between bolts on a bolt circle from bolt count and pitch diameter.
formulas.note: Arc spacing is circumference/n; straight center-to-center chord spacing is PCD·sin(π/n), and angular spacing is 360°/n.

formulas.name: Drill Point Length
formulas.description: Point length of a drill from its diameter and the point angle.
formulas.note: Ideal symmetric conical drill point from diameter and included point angle; verify the actual tool geometry before blind-hole depth decisions.

formulas.name: One-Across Strip Yardage
formulas.description: Estimate yardage when each piece spans the usable fabric width and piece lengths are laid end to end.
formulas.note: Assumes one full-width piece per stated length, laid end to end; it does not optimize a multi-piece cutting layout. Account separately for fabric width, orientation, repeats, and nap if that assumption does not hold.

formulas.name: Button Spacing
formulas.description: Even spacing between buttons from the total length and the button count.
formulas.note: Divides the full length into n+1 equal gaps: one before the first button, n−1 between buttons, and one after the last.

formulas.name: Seam Allowance Total
formulas.description: Total fabric taken by seam allowances from seam length and allowance per side.
formulas.note: Both sides: length · allowance · 2.

formulas.name: Bias Binding Length
formulas.description: Bias binding length needed from the edge perimeter and a waste factor.
formulas.note: Add waste for joins and corners.

formulas.name: Quilt Binding Length
formulas.description: Binding strip length from quilt width, length, and joining extra.
formulas.note: Perimeter plus joining extra.

formulas.name: Knitting Stitch Count
formulas.description: Number of stitches to cast on from desired width and stitches-per-inch gauge.
formulas.note: Stitches = width · gauge.

formulas.name: Knitting Row Count
formulas.description: Number of rows to knit from desired length and rows-per-inch gauge.
formulas.note: Rows = length · row gauge.

formulas.name: Crochet Yardage Estimator
formulas.description: Total yarn yardage from per-project yardage and number of projects.
formulas.note: Total = per-project · count.

formulas.name: Fabric Weight (GSM)
formulas.description: Fabric weight in g/m² from a sample weight and its dimensions.
formulas.note: GSM = weight / area.

workbenches.name: Recreation Formula Workbench
workbenches.description: Explore archery, model rocketry, pottery, tabletop-game, and cycling calculations for planning and recreation.

formulas.name: Clay Shrinkage
formulas.description: Fired size of a clay piece from wet size and the shrinkage percentage.
formulas.note: Fired = wet · (1 − shrink%).

formulas.name: Glaze Batch Amount
formulas.description: Amount of a glaze component from total batch size and the component percentage.
formulas.note: Component = total · percent / 100.

formulas.name: Kiln Firing Cost
formulas.description: Cost of a kiln firing from power, run time, and electricity rate.
formulas.note: Cost = kW · hours · rate.

formulas.name: Thrown Cylinder Volume
formulas.description: Clay volume of a thrown cylinder from diameter and height.
formulas.note: V = πr²h.

formulas.name: Clay Weight Needed
formulas.description: Clay weight from required volume and clay density.
formulas.note: Weight = volume · density.

formulas.name: Dice Average Roll
formulas.description: Average total of rolling a number of dice each with given sides.
formulas.note: Mean per die = (sides+1)/2.

formulas.name: Dice Success Probability
formulas.description: Probability of rolling at or above a target on a die.
formulas.note: P = (sides−target+1)/sides.

guards.message: Target must not exceed the number of sides.

formulas.name: Dice Expected Successes
formulas.description: Expected number of successes when rolling dice needing a target or higher.
formulas.note: E = n · (sides−target+1)/sides.

guards.message: Target must not exceed the number of sides.

formulas.name: RPG Carrying Capacity
formulas.description: Light-load carrying capacity in pounds from a strength score (×15 rule).
formulas.note: Common ×15 strength rule.

formulas.name: RPG Loot Split
formulas.description: Per-adventurer share of loot from total coins and party size.
formulas.note: Equal split.

formulas.name: Cycling Gear Inches
formulas.description: Gear inches from chainring, cog, and wheel diameter.
formulas.note: Gear inches = chainring/cog · wheel dia.

formulas.name: Cycling Rollout
formulas.description: Distance per pedal revolution (rollout) from gear ratio and wheel diameter.
formulas.note: Rollout = gear inches · π.

formulas.name: Cycling Gradient
formulas.description: Road gradient percentage from vertical ascent and horizontal distance.
formulas.note: Gradient (%) = rise/run·100; rise and run must use the same unit.

formulas.name: Cycling Speed from Cadence
formulas.description: Speed from gear ratio, wheel circumference, and cadence.
formulas.note: Speed = gear ratio·wheel circumference·cadence·60/1000; circumference must be in metres.

formulas.name: Cycling Climbing Power
formulas.description: Power to climb at a gradient from mass, grade, and speed.
formulas.note: Idealized gravity-only climbing power P = mgv·grade. Grade is a decimal ratio (0.08 means 8%); rolling and aerodynamic losses are omitted.

workbenches.name: Environment & Fluid Formula Workbench
workbenches.description: Calculate water, airflow, weather, lighting, and fluid-system relationships with stated idealizations.

formulas.name: Manning's Flow
formulas.description: Open-channel flow rate from area, hydraulic radius, slope, and Manning's n.
formulas.note: Manning estimate Q=(A/n)R^(2/3)√S; n, wetted area, and hydraulic radius must be positive, with nonnegative slope.

formulas.name: Orifice Flow Rate
formulas.description: Flow rate through a sharp-edged orifice from coefficient, diameter, and head.
formulas.note: Q = Cd·A·√(2gh).

formulas.name: Rectangular Weir Flow
formulas.description: Flow rate over a rectangular weir from crest width and head above the crest.

formulas.name: Pipe Flow Velocity
formulas.description: Mean velocity in a full pipe from flow rate and pipe diameter.
formulas.note: v = Q/A.

formulas.name: Hydrostatic Force on Wall
formulas.description: Total hydrostatic force on a vertical wall from fluid density, depth, and wall width.
formulas.note: F = ½ρg·h²·w (acts at 2h/3).

formulas.name: Pitot Tube Velocity
formulas.description: Flow velocity from a Pitot tube differential pressure and fluid density.

formulas.name: Bernoulli Efflux Velocity
formulas.description: Efflux velocity of a fluid leaving a tank under a given head (Torricelli's law).

formulas.name: Hydraulic Radius
formulas.description: Hydraulic radius of a channel from its flow area and wetted perimeter.
formulas.note: R = A/P.

formulas.name: Specific Gravity
formulas.description: Specific gravity of a substance from its density and a reference density (water).
formulas.note: SG = ρ/ρ_water.

formulas.name: Flow Rate from Velocity
formulas.description: Volumetric flow rate from cross-sectional area and velocity.
formulas.note: Q = A·v.

formulas.name: HVAC Cooling Load
formulas.description: Quick cooling load estimate from floor area and a watts-per-area factor.
formulas.note: Screening estimate: floor area multiplied by an assumed load factor in W/m²; it is not a heat-load calculation.

formulas.name: Air Changes per Hour
formulas.description: Air change rate from supply airflow (CFM) and room volume.
formulas.note: ACH = CFM·60/volume; airflow must be ft³/min and room volume ft³.

formulas.name: Duct Velocity
formulas.description: Air velocity in a duct from airflow (CFM) and duct cross-sectional area.
formulas.note: v = CFM / area.

formulas.name: Lux from Lumens
formulas.description: Illuminance in lux from total luminous flux and the lit area.
formulas.note: lux = lumens / m².

formulas.name: Watts to Lumens
formulas.description: Luminous flux in lumens from electrical power and luminous efficacy.
formulas.note: lumens = watts · efficacy.

formulas.name: Rainfall Volume
formulas.description: Water volume collected from a catchment area and rainfall depth (1 mm over 1 m² = 1 L).
formulas.note: 1 mm/m² = 1 L.

formulas.name: Snow Water Equivalent
formulas.description: Water depth from snow depth and the snow's water-density fraction.
formulas.note: Water depth = snow depth·water-equivalent fraction; fraction is constrained from 0 to 1.

formulas.name: Earthquake Energy
formulas.description: Energy released from moment magnitude using the Gutenberg formula.

formulas.name: Wind Power Density
formulas.description: Power available per unit area from air density and wind speed.
formulas.note: P/A = ½ρv³.

workbenches.name: Photography Formula Workbench
workbenches.description: Work with optics, exposure, print resolution, field of view, and astrophotography planning formulas.

formulas.name: Hyperfocal Distance
formulas.description: Hyperfocal distance from focal length, aperture, and circle of confusion.
formulas.note: H = f²/(N·c) + f.

formulas.name: Print Resolution (DPI)
formulas.description: Print resolution in DPI from image pixels and the printed size.
formulas.note: DPI = pixels / inches.

formulas.name: Flash Guide Number
formulas.description: Flash guide number from aperture and the distance for correct exposure.
formulas.note: Guide number = f-number·distance for the guide number's stated ISO (commonly ISO 100); ISO changes require adjustment.

formulas.name: ND Filter Shutter
formulas.description: Adjusted shutter speed from base shutter and ND filter stops.
formulas.note: Shutter = base · 2^stops.

formulas.name: Field of View
formulas.description: Field of view in degrees from sensor dimension and focal length.
formulas.note: Angular field of view = 2·atan(sensor dimension/(2f)); enter one sensor dimension for the matching horizontal, vertical, or diagonal FOV.

formulas.name: Camera Crop Factor
formulas.description: Crop factor relative to full frame from the sensor diagonal.
formulas.note: Uses a 43.27 mm full-frame (36×24 mm) diagonal reference.

formulas.name: Star Trail 500 Rule
formulas.description: Max shutter for pin-point stars from focal length using the 500 rule.
formulas.note: 500 rule: shutter ≤ 500 / focal length.

formulas.name: Macro Magnification
formulas.description: Magnification from extension tube length and lens focal length.
formulas.note: Extension/focal length estimates added magnification from extension alone, not total lens magnification.

workbenches.name: Audio Formula Workbench
workbenches.description: Calculate acoustic levels, impedance, pitch, delay, distance, and wavelength relationships.

formulas.name: Acoustic Impedance
formulas.description: Acoustic impedance of a medium from its density and speed of sound.
formulas.note: Z = ρc.

formulas.name: Decibel Power Ratio
formulas.description: Decibel gain between two power levels.
formulas.note: L=10·log10(P1/P2); both power values must be positive and comparable.

formulas.name: Sound Intensity Level
formulas.description: Sound intensity level in dB relative to a reference intensity.
formulas.note: L=10·log10(I/I0); both intensities must be positive and use the same units.

formulas.name: Combine Two Sound Levels
formulas.description: Total sound level in dB from combining two independent sources.

formulas.name: MIDI Note Frequency
formulas.description: Frequency of a musical note from its MIDI note number (A4 = 69 = 440 Hz).
formulas.note: Equal temperament with A4=MIDI 69 at 440 Hz; MIDI note must be an integer from 0 to 127.

formulas.name: Cents Between Frequencies
formulas.description: Interval in cents between two frequencies.
formulas.note: cents=1200·log2(f/f0); both frequencies must be positive.

formulas.name: Sound Travel Time
formulas.description: Time for sound to cross a distance in air at 343 m/s.
formulas.note: Uses a fixed 343 m/s speed of sound, approximately dry air at 20 °C; temperature and medium change the result.

formulas.name: Wavelength from Delay
formulas.description: Acoustic wavelength from a delay in milliseconds (speed 343 m/s).
formulas.note: Uses a fixed 343 m/s speed of sound, approximately dry air at 20 °C; the input is converted from milliseconds.
